summary: Free desktop cowork app with a built-in AI agent that also drives Claude Code, Codex and 20+ other agents, using any API key.

heroCommands.command: Get the installer for macOS, Windows or Linux from the Releases page

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: AionUi is a free, open-source cowork app with AI agents. It ships with its own agent engine that can read and write files, search the web, generate images and use MCP tools, and it can also work with CLI agents such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Hermes.
sixtySeconds.problem: Most agent tools need command-line setup. AionUi works as soon as you install it and paste an API key, with a friendly desktop interface.
whoFor: People who want agents without the terminal
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for zero-setup agents, multi-agent support, remote access, 24/7 automation and 21 ready assistants for slides, Word and Excel.
requirements: An API key for a model provider

overview: Get started in three steps: install AionUi, enter any API key, and start coworking with the built-in agent.

The built-in agent handles files, web search, image generation and MCP tools, and there are 21 assistants such as PPT Creator, Word Creator and Excel Creator. It also connects to Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and 20+ other agents.
Install from the Releases page or with Homebrew on macOS. AionUi is Apache 2.0 licensed.
